title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO After U.S. Input
summary: Nvidia&\#x27;s board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board director, according to the Nvidia newsroom announcement linked in a Hacker News post. The board statement, quoted in the discussion, says it received input from senior levels of the U.S. government and is confident that Huang&\#x27;s reinstatement poses no national security risk. The post also links to a CNBC report but supplies no article text, so the circumstances of Huang&\#x27;s earlier departure and the government&\#x27;s role remain unverified in the supplied material.
